title: Awesome Fluffy American Cheddar Cheese Casserole
description: A delicious and fluffy American casserole featuring cheddar cheese and a mirepoix base, perfect for a comforting meal. This dish is satvik-friendly and packed with umami flavor.

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: sharp or extra sharp work best

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the onion, carrot, and celery in butter until tender.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, vegetable broth, and milk.
Add the shredded cheese to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the cooked mirepoix mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until it is golden brown and set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
